text: ShortsOS does not offer this workflow as a generally or instantly available product. A pilot does not include linking your own Instagram account, and it does not let a customer publish directly. It also carries no proof of repeated volume: what has been shown is one documented real run. No pilot comes with a promise of creative quality, performance or virality. If a vendor promises you more than it can show, that gap is worth naming before any work starts.
